en.text: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,

zhSimplified.text: 我儿，你若为朋友作保， 替外人击掌，

zhTraditional.text: 我兒，你若為朋友作保， 替外人擊掌，

en.text: you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.

zhSimplified.text: 你就被口中的话语缠住， 被嘴里的言语捉住。

zhTraditional.text: 你就被口中的話語纏住， 被嘴裏的言語捉住。

en.text: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.

zhSimplified.text: 我儿，你既落在朋友手中， 就当这样行才可救自己： 你要自卑，去恳求你的朋友。

zhTraditional.text: 我兒，你既落在朋友手中， 就當這樣行才可救自己： 你要自卑，去懇求你的朋友。

en.text: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.

zhSimplified.text: 不要容你的眼睛睡觉； 不要容你的眼皮打盹。

zhTraditional.text: 不要容你的眼睛睡覺； 不要容你的眼皮打盹。

en.text: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

zhSimplified.text: 要救自己，如鹿脱离猎户的手， 如鸟脱离捕鸟人的手。

zhTraditional.text: 要救自己，如鹿脫離獵戶的手， 如鳥脫離捕鳥人的手。

en.text: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;

zhSimplified.text: 懒惰人哪， 你去察看蚂蚁的动作就可得智慧。

zhTraditional.text: 懶惰人哪， 你去察看螞蟻的動作就可得智慧。

en.text: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

zhSimplified.text: 蚂蚁没有元帅， 没有官长，没有君王，

zhTraditional.text: 螞蟻沒有元帥， 沒有官長，沒有君王，

en.text: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.

zhSimplified.text: 尚且在夏天预备食物， 在收割时聚敛粮食。

zhTraditional.text: 尚且在夏天預備食物， 在收割時聚斂糧食。

en.text: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?

zhSimplified.text: 懒惰人哪，你要睡到几时呢？ 你何时睡醒呢？

zhTraditional.text: 懶惰人哪，你要睡到幾時呢？ 你何時睡醒呢？

en.text: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep—

zhSimplified.text: 再睡片时，打盹片时， 抱着手躺卧片时，

zhTraditional.text: 再睡片時，打盹片時， 抱着手躺臥片時，

en.text: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.

zhSimplified.text: 你的贫穷就必如强盗速来， 你的缺乏仿佛拿兵器的人来到。

zhTraditional.text: 你的貧窮就必如強盜速來， 你的缺乏彷彿拿兵器的人來到。

en.text: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,

zhSimplified.text: 无赖的恶徒， 行动就用乖僻的口，

zhTraditional.text: 無賴的惡徒， 行動就用乖僻的口，

en.text: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,

zhSimplified.text: 用眼传神， 用脚示意， 用指点划，

zhTraditional.text: 用眼傳神， 用腳示意， 用指點劃，

en.text: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.

zhSimplified.text: 心中乖僻， 常设恶谋， 布散纷争。

zhTraditional.text: 心中乖僻， 常設惡謀， 布散紛爭。

en.text: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，灾难必忽然临到他身； 他必顷刻败坏，无法可治。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，災難必忽然臨到他身； 他必頃刻敗壞，無法可治。

en.text: There are six things which the LORD hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华所恨恶的有六样， 连他心所憎恶的共有七样：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華所恨惡的有六樣， 連他心所憎惡的共有七樣：

en.text: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,

zhSimplified.text: 就是高傲的眼， 撒谎的舌， 流无辜人血的手，

zhTraditional.text: 就是高傲的眼， 撒謊的舌， 流無辜人血的手，

en.text: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,

zhSimplified.text: 图谋恶计的心， 飞跑行恶的脚，

zhTraditional.text: 圖謀惡計的心， 飛跑行惡的腳，

en.text: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.

zhSimplified.text: 吐谎言的假见证， 并弟兄中布散纷争的人。

zhTraditional.text: 吐謊言的假見證， 並弟兄中布散紛爭的人。

en.text: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.

zhSimplified.text: 我儿，要谨守你父亲的诫命； 不可离弃你母亲的法则，

zhTraditional.text: 我兒，要謹守你父親的誡命； 不可離棄你母親的法則，

en.text: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.

zhSimplified.text: 要常系在你心上， 挂在你项上。

zhTraditional.text: 要常繫在你心上， 掛在你項上。

en.text: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.

zhSimplified.text: 你行走，它必引导你； 你躺卧，它必保守你； 你睡醒，它必与你谈论。

zhTraditional.text: 你行走，它必引導你； 你躺臥，它必保守你； 你睡醒，它必與你談論。

en.text: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,

zhSimplified.text: 因为诫命是灯，法则是光， 训诲的责备是生命的道，

zhTraditional.text: 因為誡命是燈，法則是光， 訓誨的責備是生命的道，

en.text: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.

zhSimplified.text: 能保你远离恶妇， 远离外女谄媚的舌头。

zhTraditional.text: 能保你遠離惡婦， 遠離外女諂媚的舌頭。

en.text: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.

zhSimplified.text: 你心中不要恋慕她的美色， 也不要被她眼皮勾引。

zhTraditional.text: 你心中不要戀慕她的美色， 也不要被她眼皮勾引。

en.text: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.

zhSimplified.text: 因为，妓女能使人只剩一块饼； 淫妇猎取人宝贵的生命。

zhTraditional.text: 因為，妓女能使人只剩一塊餅； 淫婦獵取人寶貴的生命。

en.text: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?

zhSimplified.text: 人若怀里搋火， 衣服岂能不烧呢？

zhTraditional.text: 人若懷裏搋火， 衣服豈能不燒呢？

en.text: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?

zhSimplified.text: 人若在火炭上走， 脚岂能不烫呢？

zhTraditional.text: 人若在火炭上走， 腳豈能不燙呢？

en.text: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.

zhSimplified.text: 亲近邻舍之妻的，也是如此； 凡挨近她的，不免受罚。

zhTraditional.text: 親近鄰舍之妻的，也是如此； 凡挨近她的，不免受罰。

en.text: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry,

zhSimplified.text: 贼因饥饿偷窃充饥， 人不藐视他，

zhTraditional.text: 賊因飢餓偷竊充飢， 人不藐視他，

en.text: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.

zhSimplified.text: 若被找着，他必赔还七倍， 必将家中所有的尽都偿还。

zhTraditional.text: 若被找着，他必賠還七倍， 必將家中所有的盡都償還。

en.text: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.

zhSimplified.text: 与妇人行淫的，便是无知； 行这事的，必丧掉生命。

zhTraditional.text: 與婦人行淫的，便是無知； 行這事的，必喪掉生命。

en.text: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.

zhSimplified.text: 他必受伤损，必被凌辱； 他的羞耻不得涂抹。

zhTraditional.text: 他必受傷損，必被凌辱； 他的羞恥不得塗抹。

en.text: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.

zhSimplified.text: 因为人的嫉恨成了烈怒， 报仇的时候决不留情。

zhTraditional.text: 因為人的嫉恨成了烈怒， 報仇的時候決不留情。

en.text: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.

zhSimplified.text: 什么赎价，他都不顾； 你虽送许多礼物，他也不肯干休。

zhTraditional.text: 甚麼贖價，他都不顧； 你雖送許多禮物，他也不肯干休。
